[SWS_CM_99030] Find Service Handle
⌈
To identify a triggered request
to find a service, the StartFindService method of [SWS_CM_00123] shall re-
turn a FindServiceHandle which is used as parameter to cancel this request
with StopFindService as described in [SWS_CM_00125].
⌋
